issues.quote: The page names its three gaps, then the cost, ending with the part that matters most
issues.text: The prose says the page names three gaps but never says what they are; only the Vietnamese block lists them. The cost is paraphrased in English, the gaps are not, so a reader skimming the prose has to go back to the quote to learn them.
issues.fix: After 'names its three gaps' add '— no version, no context, no constraint —'.

issues.quote: and a written-out failure costs minutes: whatever line it points you at, the failing sample confirms or refutes.
issues.text: Read twice. 'it' could be the written-out failure or the assistant's reply, and 'confirms or refutes' has no object, so I had to rebuild 'one run of the sample tells you whether that line is the bug'.
issues.fix: Rewrite as: 'and writing out a failure costs minutes: whatever line it leads you to, one run of the failing sample confirms or refutes that the bug is there.'

issues.quote: You confirm an explanation by running the code
issues.text: I could not see how running code confirms an explanation. The missing step: the explanation says what the code will do on some input, you run it on that input and compare.
issues.fix: Change to 'You confirm an explanation by running the code on an input and checking it does what the explanation said it would'.

issues.quote: Ask for the reasoning and for a page you can open, so the answer arrives with its own handle for checking.
issues.text: This adds a sixth request beyond the five parts, but the good example in section 5 asks for no page, the Try it does not mention it, and the summary drops it. I was unsure whether a prompt without it is complete.
issues.fix: Either add half a sentence saying this is optional on top of the five parts, or point at the example's 'what in .NET makes it happen' as the version of this request the page uses.

issues.quote: Write the prompt you would send about this failure using that shape, with `(paste code)` where the code goes.

issues.fix: In step 2 add half a sentence saying which versions are in force for the sample (e.g. 'the sample runs on .NET 10 and does not use the database').
